adf_stationarity.interpretation: ONDO-SOL FR differential IS stationary at 1% level (stat=-11.7987 << 1% critical -3.4307). Mean-reversion assumption CONFIRMED. Single regime — no crash-driven structural break in ONDO-SOL history.

rwa_vs_svm_mechanics.cross_cluster_thesis: RWA TBills (ONDO) vs SVM (SOL): distinct primary drivers but share one common factor — 'institutional crypto adoption' narratives. When crypto gains mainstream institutional acceptance: both SOL (ETF/Firedancer) and ONDO (BUIDL) see elevated FR simultaneously. This SOL-AVAX co-movement creates the G5c AVAX structural overlap: institutional narratives driving SOL and AVAX FRs in sync.
